quarterly_data.signal: NAVER Corporation half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, consolidated K-IFRS, reviewed by Samjong KPMG; Naver Cloud is a 100%-owned subsidiary reported inside the 'Global Challenge' service line): Q2 2026 (04-01-2026 to 06-30-2026) operating revenue KRW 3,388,755M vs KRW 2,915,085M in Q2 2025 (+16.2% YoY); Q2 operating profit KRW 520,309M vs KRW 521,554M (-0.2% YoY, 15.4% margin); Q2 net profit KRW 704,273M vs KRW 497,358M (+41.6%, lifted by KRW 244,323M financial income and KRW 238,652M equity-method gains); Q2 basic EPS KRW 4,665 vs 3,256. H1 2026: revenue KRW 6,629,816M vs KRW 5,701,868M (+16.3%), operating profit KRW 1,062,067M vs KRW 1,026,855M (+3.4%, 16.0% margin vs 18.0%), net profit KRW 995,294M vs KRW 921,020M, basic EPS KRW 6,573 vs 6,089; operating expenses KRW 5,567,750M (+19.1%). MIX H1 (segment classification was changed this half and the comparative restated): Naver Platform (search, display and commerce ads, shopping, Place) KRW 3,741,951M = 56.5% (+13.5% YoY); Financial Platform (payments, digital finance) KRW 930,315M = 14.0% (+17.4%); Global Challenge (C2C, webtoon, SNOW, NAVER Cloud Platform 'NCP', NAVER WORKS) KRW 1,957,550M = 29.5% (+21.4% from KRW 1,611,813M), the fastest-growing line and the one that carries the cloud/AI business. GEOGRAPHY H1 by entity domicile: Korea KRW 5,522,921M, Japan KRW 592,883M, US KRW 371,599M, other KRW 142,414M (vs KRW 61,585M a year ago, reflecting the Wallapop consolidation). Wallapop (Spain, C2C) acquired 100% for EUR 563M (EUR 377M excluding the C-Fund stake), closed 01-30-2026, goodwill KRW 780,105M, KRW 87,629M revenue and KRW 5,565M net profit consolidated since acquisition. R&D expense H1 KRW 633,219M = 18.7% of revenue (H1 2025: 18.4%). Balance sheet 06-30-2026: cash KRW 6,384,370M plus short-term financial instruments KRW 2,017,073M; bonds KRW 2,020,838M and borrowings KRW 1,873,755M after the USD 500M/EUR 500M green notes issued 04-21-2026 and repayment of the USD 800M and KRW 450,000M notes maturing in Q1; equity KRW 31,029,795M; H1 operating cash flow KRW 1,186,558M. Subsidiary NAVER Cloud Corp. (Bundang, 100% owned, book value KRW 201,671M) had FY2025 total assets KRW 2,328,935M and FY2025 net profit KRW 165,643M; NAVER Cloud's overseas IT-infrastructure subsidiaries are NAVER Cloud Asia Pacific (Singapore, assets KRW 61,230M), NAVER Cloud Japan (KRW 37,029M), NAVER Cloud America (San Jose, KRW 27,506M) and NAVER Cloud Europe (Frankfurt, KRW 15,010M); LINE WORKS Corporation (Japan, 77.93%) assets KRW 254,142M. Filing cites Gartner: global cloud market USD 850B in 2026 to USD 1,480B in 2029 (~20% CAGR); Korean public cloud 2026 ~USD 8.8B (IaaS 4.2B, PaaS 1.9B, SaaS 2.7B), with growth 'driven by surging demand for GPU-based AI computing infrastructure from generative AI'; AI computing-infrastructure capacity is called 'the new competitive factor in the cloud market'.

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), B2B / sovereign-AI customer book of NAVER Cloud (no order-backlog figure is disclosed; NAVER reports a single operating segment): NAVER Cloud Platform offers 225+ services in 22 categories (end-2025) across IaaS/PaaS/SaaS; 'Neurocloud for HyperCLOVA X' (cloud infrastructure installed inside the customer's own data center so generative AI is trained on a closed network) was supplied to Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power in 2024 and the Bank of Korea in 2025, with 2026 adoption talks expanding to defense, education and finance customers. NAVER WORKS was selected in 2026 as the official collaboration platform for central ministries (Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Ministry of Science and ICT, Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) under the pan-government intelligent work-management pilot; in Japan LINE WORKS holds strong share in finance/insurance/securities and is expanding into construction, nursing, manufacturing and local governments, with the AI minutes service 'LINE WORKS AiNote'; Taiwan launched as the second overseas market in H2 2025. Sovereign AI / Middle East: NAVER Cloud's 50/50 JV 'NAVER Innovation Company' with NHC Innovation (digital arm of Saudi Arabia's National Housing Company) operates a map-based super-app and AI digital-twin platform - digital twins of Makkah, Medina and Jeddah completed by end-2025 (about 6,800 km2, more than 920,000 buildings mapped), with platform upgrades and wider Saudi roll-out planned for 2026; an MOU with the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA) covers data centers and sovereign AI; 'NAVER Arabia' regional HQ was set up in 2025 under the Saudi RHQ programme; the JV generated KRW 3,586M of H1 2026 revenue for the group, carried a KRW 12,514M trade receivable at 06-30-2026 and received KRW 34,350M of capital in H1. Filing states NAVER Cloud is 'consolidating leadership in the global sovereign-AI market' with multiple AI projects in the Middle East and Asia. Intra-group demand: NAVER Corp (parent) bought KRW 435,816M of infrastructure services from NAVER Cloud in H1 2026 (KRW 450,366M in H1 2025) and sold KRW 52,898M to it; the parent carried KRW 123,450M payable to NAVER Cloud at 06-30-2026. LY Corporation (LINE/Yahoo Japan) is winding down its search-service contract with NAVER (related-party revenue from LY fell to KRW 27,888M in H1 2026 from KRW 125,092M), and NAVER shares up to JPY 3,400M of the credit-enhancement cost LY gave its landlord when terminating a data-center lease.

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), capex and AI data-center build-out (consolidated): H1 2026 CapEx KRW 854.1B vs KRW 367.5B in H1 2025 (2.3x) - Q2 alone KRW 402.8B vs KRW 162.8B; of the H1 total, servers and equipment KRW 741.1B (vs KRW 336.4B, 2.2x), land and buildings KRW 68.7B (vs KRW 15.1B), intangibles KRW 44.3B; cash paid for PP&E KRW 809,757M vs KRW 350,866M. Filing text: 'we are investing in land, buildings and servers for the Chuncheon and cloud data centers and additional office space'. Machinery (servers) net book value rose to KRW 2,078,302M at 06-30-2026 from KRW 1,609,950M at year-end after KRW 682,402M of additions and KRW 210,947M of depreciation; total PP&E KRW 4,122,715M vs KRW 3,607,614M. Owned IDC assets: Sejong data center land KRW 88,469M and building KRW 507,791M plus KRW 86,724M of facilities; Chuncheon data center land KRW 29,501M (KRW 2,877M added) and building KRW 171,183M (KRW 19,521M added in H1); construction in progress KRW 130,988M, of which Sejong KRW 115,035M (KRW 78,423M added in H1), a new US project KRW 5,719M and France KRW 7,928M. Data-center construction contracts with Xi C&A and one other contractor total KRW 548,332M with KRW 454,890M still to be spent at 06-30-2026, plus a KRW 51,000M land purchase (KRW 100M remaining); borrowing costs of KRW 319M were capitalised on qualifying assets at 2.33%. Leased capacity: right-of-use IDC buildings KRW 867,947M (vs KRW 765,003M at year-end) and IDC ROU depreciation KRW 86,803M in H1 vs KRW 40,982M a year earlier (2.1x), variable lease expense KRW 68,542M vs KRW 6,512M; an asset-lease facility of KRW 80,695M is in place with Cisco Systems Capital and others; total lease cash outflow KRW 207,635M. GPU / AI computing: NAVER Cloud was selected in 2026 as an operator under the Ministry of Science and ICT's advanced-GPU procurement, construction and operation support programme and is building and operating about 4,000 latest-generation GPUs; for the National AI Computing Center it holds 26.06% of the SPV 'Korea AI Computing Center (KOACC)' established June 2026 (KRW 104,400M committed, KRW 29,500M paid in H1, KRW 74,900M remaining). Power: over 20GWh of renewable power used at owned offices and data centers in 2025, a new 7MW third-party renewable PPA for offices and data centers, wind-farm equity plus PPA to secure data-center renewables (30% stake in AWP Co., a renewables-generation vehicle, acquired 06-30-2026 for KRW 19,200M); the ESG committee approved a 'data-center renewable energy procurement contract' on 04-06-2026; all directly operated sites and data centers are ISO 14001 certified. The 2026 H1 CapEx is funded partly by USD 500M 4.38% 2031 and EUR 500M 3.75% 2033 senior unsecured green notes issued 04-21-2026 (Moody's A3 / S&P A-, both assigned 04-08-2026) for refinancing ESG bonds and eligible green projects.

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), catalysts and corporate events: NVIDIA EQUITY INVESTMENT - NAVER disclosed a forward business plan on 06-08-2026 (corrected 07-27-2026) under which NVIDIA will subscribe to a third-party allotment of about USD 1B of new NAVER common shares; the 07-27-2026 board resolution (material report on the capital increase) ties the NVIDIA-directed placement to 'a new AI Factory business', with payment due by 10-30-2026 and listing of the new shares by 11-20-2026 as the contractual outside dates, subject to conditions precedent that the company expects to be met earlier (dates to be re-disclosed once fixed). NVIDIA NEMOTRON COALITION - in June 2026 NAVER Cloud became the first Korean company to join the NVIDIA-led open-model 'Nemotron Coalition', collaborating to upgrade HyperCLOVA X. Model pipeline (R&D table, completed 2025-2026): HyperCLOVA X SEED 32B Think (partial-omni: text, image, document, streaming audio; top Korean benchmarks and first in five agentic tool-use areas), HyperCLOVA X SEED 8B Omni (any-to-any audio/vision/video), Korean token efficiency 2-5x via 'Prune & Graft', RLVR anti-hallucination training, interleaved-thinking agent architecture, video-token compression, streaming TTS 2x faster, KoNET/KoSimpleQA benchmarks, Omni-Evaluator (2026) integrated with vLLM/SGLang; infrastructure R&D includes Nubes/Lemon distributed storage, NSML GPU-farm platform, CLOps model-serving cloud, Ncloud Storage (S3-compatible object storage, in progress), a GPU transcoder farm 'n3r' with AI Encode NEO (15-20% bitrate/storage saving), a container-based cloud-native platform and a hybrid-cloud live-streaming architecture. AI on the consumer side: AI shopping agent moved to full service at end-June 2026 and expanded to mobile web; ADVoost search/shopping AI ad products launched. Share count and returns: 4,901,094 treasury shares (KRW 1,017,000M, 3.12%) cancelled 08-03-2026 (board 07-24-2026); FY2025 dividend KRW 2,630/share (KRW 393,596M, 30% of two-year average consolidated FCF) paid; 2025-2027 policy returns 25-35% of two-year average FCF via dividends or buybacks; 156,944,242 shares outstanding at 06-30-2026, NPS 8.91%, BlackRock 6.12%. Other: Naver Financial's share swap to make Dunamu (Upbit) a 100% subsidiary (disclosed 11-27-2025) is under regulatory review; KRW 130,000M capital injection into KREAM disclosed 08-04-2026; cumulative voting takes effect 09-10-2026 after the 03-23-2026 AGM charter change; CFO Kim Hee-cheol joined the board as inside director on 03-23-2026 and chairs the ESG committee; founder Lee Hae-jin is board chairman. Share price monthly average fell from KRW 257,714 (Jan 2026) to KRW 205,717 (May) and recovered to KRW 234,762 in June with record June volume of 75.8M shares; 06-30-2026 close KRW 199,000.
